blocks.section: Remove the inboard labyrinth oil seal
blocks.content: Labyrinth oil-seal O-rings are part of  the 3196 maintenance kits, and they are sold separately.

blocks.content: Determine the fit of  your labyrinth oil seal.

blocks.section: Remove the inboard labyrinth oil seal
blocks.content: Remove the O-rings (497H and 497J) and the seal (333A).

blocks.content: Remove the clamp screws (370C) and back off the jam nuts (423).

blocks.content: Tighten the jack screws (370D) evenly to move the bearing housing (134) out of  the bearing frame (228A).
